Nandigram Bypoll Candidate Seeks Bail from Calcutta High Court

Milan Pradhan, a candidate in the Nandigram bypoll, has approached the Calcutta High Court seeking bail. Pradhan was arrested in connection with the bypoll. The timing of his arrest has raised questions, according to one report.
